purpose: Audit-faithful implementation-fidelity correction of btc-eth-long-only-mean-reversion-v1, not strategy improvement or parameter search.
economic_hypothesis: Short-lived liquidity demand, forced selling, and asynchronous price discovery can create temporary one-to-five-session overshoots in liquid BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT spot markets. A large negative three-session return standardized only by completed-session volatility may therefore partially reverse before five causal execution intervals elapse. The hypothesis is falsified if conservative costs, delay, cross-fold, asset, parameter, regime, concentration, and statistical gates do not all pass.

phase_1_preservation.prior_evidence_treatment: The reported v1 result, including +14.60% primary development net return, is contaminated diagnostic prior evidence. It remains immutable, counts toward multiplicity, cannot justify a performance claim, and cannot select or alter any v2 parameter, gate, cost, fold, seed, or implementation choice.
phase_1_preservation.immutability: Nothing in this v2 contract rewrites, deletes, softens, relabels, or reuses the v1 result as valid frozen-strategy evidence.

unchanged_from_v1.economic_definition: Contrarian standardized three-session drawdown entry with recovery or five-interval exit; independent long-or-cash state per asset; no trend signal, breakout, momentum sign, volatility targeting, leverage, shorting, funding, or borrow.
unchanged_from_v1.trial_order_and_parameters: Exactly the seven v1 trials declared below, with the primary fixed first and ineligible for replacement.
unchanged_from_v1.acceptance_gate_thresholds: Exactly the v1 development_gates_all_required object declared below; no threshold is weakened or added after observing v1.
unchanged_from_v1.holdout_and_prospective_thresholds: Exactly the v1 numerical thresholds and one-shot opening rule, subject only to the stronger Phase 2 prerequisite that implementation fidelity and robustness audits pass before opening.

implementation_fidelity_corrections_only.fill_then_decision: A previously scheduled order that fills before a completed-session decision updates actual state and clears pending first. The valid decision at the later completed session is then evaluated from that post-fill actual state. The fact that a fill executed earlier in the session is never itself a suppression condition; only an order still pending at the decision information time suppresses a new decision.
implementation_fidelity_corrections_only.quarantine_gap_segmentation: Cash paths are split at every causally detected incomplete or asynchronous boundary. No return interval, genuine-cash zero, state, indicator, target, fill, cost, or statistical panel may bridge from before a quarantine trigger to after recovery.
implementation_fidelity_corrections_only.causal_regime_history: Regime closes, returns, rolling volatility estimates, and expanding-median history use only contiguous complete synchronized sessions known by the interval-start information cutoff and reset completely at every quarantine trigger.
implementation_fidelity_corrections_only.strict_fold_prefix: Every fold is sliced to its strict row prefix before session construction, gap detection, target generation, execution mapping, regime calculation, or accounting. Rows, gaps, or availability events at or after the fold end cannot affect the fold.
implementation_fidelity_corrections_only.production_input_identity: The real loader verifies the frozen source commit, exact relative path, byte count, and SHA-256 before parsing each development file, reuses the verified bytes for parse, and passes PyArrow a list-valued column selector.
implementation_fidelity_corrections_only.trace_reconciliation: Every decision, target, fill, cancellation, cost, interval return, and terminal disposition is canonically hashed and independently reconciled. Every target has exactly one terminal disposition and every reported return is derivable from adjacent verified fills.
implementation_fidelity_corrections_only.derived_integrity: Leakage, holdout closure, terminal cash, trace completeness, and gate-count claims are derived from validated evidence and cannot be hard-coded booleans.
implementation_fidelity_corrections_only.scope: These changes correct mechanics and evidence only. They do not alter the economic hypothesis, signal inputs, parameter values, weights, costs, variants, fold dates, thresholds, or seed.

data_identity_contract.development_allowlist_derivation: From the reused contract's ordered partitions, select only verification_scope=HASH_AND_SCHEMA_METADATA_ONLY and serialize an array containing exactly bytes, month, relative_path, sha256, and symbol with sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8; SHA-256 must equal the declared hash.
data_identity_contract.pre_open_verification: Before resolving, stating, opening, parsing, or inspecting metadata for any development file: validate both contract hashes, the source repository commit, freeze and inventory hashes, allowlist count, and allowlist hash. For each selected file validate its exact allowlisted relative path without traversal, regular-file status, byte count, and SHA-256; parse from the same verified byte buffer to prevent time-of-check/time-of-use substitution.
data_identity_contract.parser_contract: PyArrow columns is exactly the list [event_timestamp, available_timestamp, source_provenance, open, high, low, close, volume] where present in the frozen schema; a tuple selector is prohibited. Validate schema and types before converting. Any required-column or schema mismatch is IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED before the formal evaluation, or DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE during an authorized formal evaluation.
data_identity_contract.row_identity: For each parsed row persist the relative path, file SHA-256, zero-based row index, source_provenance, event_timestamp, available_timestamp, and canonical row SHA-256. Ordered session-input manifests bind every row used by signals or fills.
data_identity_contract.holdout_guard: Reject every 2026 path before resolution, stat, footer, schema, metadata, byte read, dataset construction, or value access unless the fixed irreversible holdout authorization and latch validate.

session_and_information_contract.expected_grid: A UTC session D contains exactly 1,440 expected minute records whose event timestamps run from D+00:01 through D+1 day+00:00, each representing the whole-minute open one minute earlier. Construct the grid from a strict boundary prefix before matching observations.
session_and_information_contract.complete_session: Exactly one record at every expected event timestamp for both assets, with finite valid OHLCV, event_timestamp equal to implied open plus one minute, available_timestamp not earlier than event_timestamp, unique ordered provenance, and no duplicate or nonmonotonic row.
session_and_information_contract.daily_ohlcv: First open, maximum high, minimum low, last close, and sum volume from a complete session only.
session_and_information_contract.information_cutoff_I_s: Maximum event_timestamp and available_timestamp over every persisted source row used by both asset decisions for completed session s.
session_and_information_contract.candidate_fill_B_s: The first whole-minute open timestamp strictly greater than I_s. The only ordinary fill record is the synchronized BTC/ETH vector whose event timestamp is B_s plus one minute and whose two rows are finite, unique, valid, and causally available. Never scan forward to a substitute ordinary fill.
session_and_information_contract.cross_asset_synchronization: Every portfolio decision and fill uses a common information set and an atomic BTC/ETH price vector at one identical B_s. Standalone diagnostics use the same joint eligibility clock before selecting one asset.
session_and_information_contract.causal_missing_detection: An invalid or duplicate row is detected at causal availability. A missing expected row is detected no earlier than its expected event time and at the availability of the first later observed row; a terminal absence with no later row is detected at the strict evaluation boundary. Persist trigger and detection timestamps.

primary_signal_contract.state_machine: independent per asset on a shared synchronized session and execution clock
primary_signal_contract.volatility_estimator: sample standard deviation ddof=1 of exactly r_(t-19) through r_t from one contiguous complete post-recovery history
primary_signal_contract.entry_rule: At I_t, if actual state is cash, no target remains pending, inputs are finite and volatility strictly positive, and z_t<=-1.5, schedule target long for B_t.
primary_signal_contract.recovery_exit_rule: At I_t, if actual state is long, no target remains pending, inputs are valid, and z_t>=-0.25, schedule target cash for B_t.
primary_signal_contract.maximum_holding_rule: If entry executes at synchronized fill index j, schedule mandatory target cash for fill j+5 unless an earlier recovery exit has executed. The five exposed intervals are j-to-j+1 through j+4-to-j+5. Holding counts actual completed execution intervals, never sessions merely observed while an order is pending.
primary_signal_contract.insufficient_input_rule: While cash, insufficient, zero, or nonfinite input preserves cash and emits no target. While long, invalid signal input never erases exposure; the mandatory execution-interval clock continues unless a quarantine rule terminates the path.

state_execution_clock_contract.initial_state: cash, no pending target, no holding clock, wealth one
state_execution_clock_contract.base_order: A target decided at I_s executes only at B_s. Actual state and entry index update at that fill, not at decision time.
state_execution_clock_contract.fill_before_later_decision: At each later I_u, first reflect every prior target whose B_s<I_u in actual state and clear it from pending. Then evaluate completed session u. A target that executed earlier does not suppress the u decision; a target whose B_s>=I_u and therefore remains pending does suppress it.
state_execution_clock_contract.one_target_rule: At most one pending target per asset. Later signals never replace, cancel, or stack with an outstanding target except quarantine or forced terminal cancellation.
state_execution_clock_contract.portfolio_atomicity: At a synchronized fill, mark both assets and cash, execute all eligible per-asset targets as one portfolio vector, charge cost once from drifted weights, then persist postcost units and wealth.
state_execution_clock_contract.additional_delay: Run an independent state machine from cash. Preserve the exact target unchanged through the base B_s and execute it at the next synchronized valid ordinary fill B_(s+1), one additional completed eligible session later. No new decision is accepted while that target is pending. The actual holding clock begins only at delayed execution and exits after five actual exposed intervals.
state_execution_clock_contract.terminal: For every half-open boundary [S,E), select the final synchronized valid ordinary fill strictly before E before simulation, declare unconditional cash at the immediately preceding eligible decision, cancel pending entries, and require costed exact cash at that fill. If actual risky exposure cannot be liquidated at that exact predeclared fill, terminate DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE; no earlier or later fallback.

missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.trigger: Any incomplete joint session, duplicate selected row, non-synchronized vector, missing exact B_s, or missing required execution fill.
missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.cash_at_detection: Remain cash, cancel a pending entry, clear holding state and every signal/regime history, start a new segment, and require 150 consecutive complete synchronized sessions before any new decision.
missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.cash_path_segmentation: Intervals touching the final pre-trigger fill, unavailable boundary, recovery span, or first post-recovery eligible fill are absent unless they are between two consecutive valid eligible fills inside the same post-recovery segment. Never bridge a gap and never zero-fill unavailable time.
missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.risky_exposure_at_detection: Terminal DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE exactly as v1; exposure and self-financing PnL cannot disappear, be reset, be imputed, or scan forward to a discretionary substitute liquidation.
missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.pending_entry_at_detection: Cancel only if actual exposure remains cash, then apply full recovery.
missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.pending_exit_or_other_risky_pending_targ: Terminal DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE because economic exposure remains live.
missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.recovery_state: cash, no target, no holding clock, and signal and regime histories rebuilt entirely from 150 new contiguous complete synchronized sessions.
failure_precedence: Input byte or trace mismatch, risky gap, missing required terminal fill, nonpositive equity, or unreconciled accounting is DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE.
A pre-run parser, production-path, gate-count, or trace-generation defect is IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED and may use only the bounded repair policy.
An audit timeout, context exhaustion, or temporary service failure is AUDIT_PENDING and may use only the bounded audit-retry policy.
Only a complete contract-faithful evaluation with one or more failed economic or robustness gates is HISTORICAL_NO_GO.
Only a complete contract-faithful evaluation with all 19 gates true is DEVELOPMENT_GO.

walk_forward_contract.fold_boundary: half-open start inclusive and end exclusive
walk_forward_contract.strict_prefix_slicing: Before expected-grid construction or any other operation, restrict source rows and causal availability events to those strictly before fold end. Appending, deleting, or corrupting any row at or after fold end cannot alter the fold's session completeness, regime history, decisions, fills, costs, returns, or classification.
walk_forward_contract.fold_initialization: Each fold begins at wealth one in exact cash with no position, pending target, entry index, holding clock, cost, PnL, quarantine state, or regime state carried from another path.
walk_forward_contract.warmup: Pre-fold rows from the allowed strict prefix may initialize contiguous indicators and regime estimates only. They cannot emit a pre-fold target or fill, establish position, advance a holding clock, generate cost or return, or transfer a quarantine state.
walk_forward_contract.first_decision: Only after the first completed session whose start is at or after fold start and only if its exact B_s is inside the fold.
walk_forward_contract.interval_assignment: Both starting and ending fills belong to the same uninterrupted segment; the starting fill is at or after fold start, the ending fill is strictly before fold end, and no interval crosses a fold or quarantine boundary.
walk_forward_contract.forced_terminal_liquidation: Use the exact predeclared terminal fill rule above for every fold and aggregate path.
walk_forward_contract.aggregate_period: Evaluate independently from cash over the full development window with its own state, terminal trade, and costs.
walk_forward_contract.purging_and_embargo: Not applicable beyond strict causal prefix isolation because parameters are fixed and no interval may cross a fold boundary.

execution_and_accounting_contract.drifted_pretrade_weights: Mark each risky unit and cash from the prior fill to current synchronized prices, divide each component by finite positive pretrade equity, and reconcile weights to one.
execution_and_accounting_contract.turnover: sum over BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT of abs(target risky weight minus drifted pretrade risky weight)
execution_and_accounting_contract.cost: pretrade equity times one-way total cost rate times turnover
execution_and_accounting_contract.postcost_allocation: Deduct cost from pretrade equity, require finite positive postcost equity, allocate risky target weights against postcost equity, and retain one minus total risky target weight as nonnegative cash.
execution_and_accounting_contract.insufficient_cash_or_nonpositive_equity: DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE; never clip, borrow, or inject capital.
execution_and_accounting_contract.initial_and_terminal_trades: Both are charged for every fold, aggregate, variant, stress, baseline, and standalone path.
execution_and_accounting_contract.buy_and_hold: Initial purchase and terminal liquidation are charged; holdings drift without rebalancing.
execution_and_accounting_contract.return_interval: Postcost equity immediately after one verified fill through pretrade equity at the next consecutive verified fill, including the next fill cost in the return ending there.
execution_and_accounting_contract.independent_recomputation: A separate pure reconciler rebuilds units, drifted weights, turnover, currency cost, postcost equity, asset PnL, interval returns, and terminal wealth from the canonical fill trace. Every value must agree within 1e-12 absolute and 1e-10 relative tolerance.
execution_and_accounting_contract.drawdown: Maximum drawdown is max_t(1-W_t/max_(u<=t)W_u) on the complete verified postcost fill-equity path including initial and terminal costs; no interval or cost is omitted.

raw_three_session_drawdown_baseline.exit: long to cash when r_t>0 or at mandatory fill j+5
raw_three_session_drawdown_baseline.accounting: identical joint clock, state ordering, fills, gaps, folds, costs, trace, and terminal liquidation

benchmarks_and_variants.selection_rule: primary_standardized_shock is fixed and can never be replaced by a variant
benchmarks_and_variants.common_panel: The exact sorted intersection of valid endpoints for all seven independently simulated trials. Include a return only when its two endpoints are consecutive eligible daily fills in the same uninterrupted segment. Missing or quarantined spans are absent, never bridged or zero-filled; genuine cash zeros require two valid consecutive endpoints.
benchmarks_and_variants.baseline_comparison: Recompute primary and each comparator Sharpe and drawdown on identical valid endpoint and fill-event panels. Baseline superiority requires primary Sharpe strictly above equal-weight buy-and-hold and raw-drawdown baseline Sharpe and primary maximum drawdown strictly below both. Every tie or nonfinite comparison fails.

trade_and_sensitivity_contract.completed_entry: one actual costed cash-to-long fill followed by an actual costed long-to-cash fill inside the same evaluation boundary
trade_and_sensitivity_contract.standalone_asset: Run identical joint eligibility, signal, holding clock, execution, costs, gaps, folds, statistics, trace, and terminal liquidation with the named asset target zero or one and residual cash.
trade_and_sensitivity_contract.asset_gate: BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT standalone aggregate net returns must each be strictly positive.

multiplicity_registry.reason_for_change_from_v1: Phase 2 explicitly requires all previous observed results to count toward multiplicity; N=49 is a stricter bookkeeping correction and does not alter the strategy.

statistical_contract.daily_return_series: All valid consecutive base execution intervals including genuine cash zeros; quarantined, unavailable, nonconsecutive, and boundary-crossing intervals are absent and never zero-filled.
statistical_contract.sharpe: sample mean divided by sample standard deviation ddof=1 times sqrt(365), risk-free zero
statistical_contract.sharpe_degenerate_rule: fewer than two returns, zero standard deviation, or any nonfinite input fails

bootstrap.seed_preservation: exact v1 seed retained rather than deriving a lucky v2 seed
bootstrap.confidence_interval: two-sided NumPy linear percentile at 0.025 and 0.975
bootstrap.degenerate_rule: fewer than two observations, nonfinite input/output, wrong seed, invalid restart, or empty replicate fails

deflated_sharpe_ratio.N: 49 only in the expected-maximum SR0 formula
deflated_sharpe_ratio.observed_sharpes: Exactly 28 hash-bound Phase 1 nonannualized daily trial Sharpes plus the seven current v2 trial Sharpes; the 14 no-return slots receive no value or pseudo-Sharpe.
deflated_sharpe_ratio.sigma_SR: sample standard deviation ddof=1 of exactly 35 observed Sharpes
deflated_sharpe_ratio.observed: current primary nonannualized Sharpe on the exact seven-trial common panel
deflated_sharpe_ratio.autocorrelation: sample autocorrelation of demeaned primary common-panel returns for lags 1 through 28
deflated_sharpe_ratio.moments: bias-false sample skew and nonexcess kurtosis
deflated_sharpe_ratio.degenerate_rule: wrong registry count/order/hash, missing current trial, invented no-return value, zero sigma, invalid autocorrelation, T_eff<30, nonpositive denominator, or nonfinite quantity yields probability zero

probability_of_backtest_overfitting.scope: seven current v2 trial returns on exact common causal timestamps
probability_of_backtest_overfitting.zero_volatility_sharpe: negative infinity unless mean strictly positive, then positive infinity
probability_of_backtest_overfitting.out_of_sample_rank: average rank worst one to best seven
probability_of_backtest_overfitting.degenerate_rule: fewer than eight observations, empty block, nonfinite value, unresolved ranking, or wrong split count yields one

exceptional_concentration.scope: aggregate portfolio and each standalone asset daily net currency PnL
exceptional_concentration.denominator: sum of strictly positive daily net PnL

regime_contract.assignment_time: At each valid execution interval start, use only the preceding completed synchronized BTC signal session known by that start.
regime_contract.trend_axis: close_s/close_(s-120)-1 strictly positive is up, equality or less is down
regime_contract.volatility_axis: 60-return sample standard deviation ddof=1 ending at s is high only when strictly above the expanding median of at least 120 prior eligible 60-return estimates excluding current; equality or less is low
regime_contract.gap_reset: Any incomplete joint session clears closes, returns, current volatility window, prior volatility-estimate median history, labels, and completed-entry eligibility. Post-gap history uses only new contiguous complete synchronized sessions.
regime_contract.development_gate: At least three regimes eligible; every eligible regime strictly positive net; no eligible regime below minus five percent net return.
regime_contract.fold_isolation: Regimes are recomputed independently on each strict fold prefix; later rows or gaps cannot change earlier labels or eligibility.
regime_contract.degenerate_rule: Insufficient history leaves the interval unlabeled; nonfinite eligible inputs fail data integrity.

development_gates_all_required.baseline_superiority: primary Sharpe strictly above both equal-weight buy-and-hold and raw-drawdown-baseline Sharpes, and primary maximum drawdown strictly below both comparators' maximum drawdowns

production_path_validation_before_formal.unit_tests: All pure signal, state, execution, accounting, statistics, gate, and failure-precedence tests pass.
production_path_validation_before_formal.real_data_integration: Run the production loader end to end against all 36 exact hash-allowlisted 2024-2025 files in the existing data-lab runtime. Exercise verified-buffer PyArrow parsing with the list-valued selector, exact expected-grid/session construction, causal fill mapping, and strict fold prefixes.
production_path_validation_before_formal.representative_rows: Without performance selection, materialize row identity and values for the first, midpoint, and last row of every allowlisted file; every row around the two known 2024-08-12 missing minutes; first and last valid row of every fold prefix; and every row used by the first two causally generated primary targets per asset if they exist. Persist only hashes and a private validation artifact; publish no raw values.
production_path_validation_before_formal.mechanical_reconciliation: On the complete development trace and predetermined representative cases, independently recompute signals, pre/post-fill state, target disposition, fills, turnover, cost, units, interval returns, terminal wealth, gaps, clocks, regimes, and fold boundaries. Validation may compute mechanical interval values but may report only counts, hashes, tolerances, and pass/fail; no aggregate return, Sharpe, gate, strategy ranking, or economic conclusion is calculated or exposed before fidelity approval.
production_path_validation_before_formal.input_hashes: Persist the exact source commit, contract hashes, allowlist hash, all 36 observed byte counts and SHA-256 values, parser/runtime versions, session-input-manifest hash, target-trace hash, fill-trace hash, and reconciliation hash.
production_path_validation_before_formal.holdout_latch_check: Prove the fixed v2 holdout latch path is absent and no 2026 path was resolved, stated, opened, parsed, or inspected.
production_path_validation_before_formal.formal_attempt_consumption: The formal economic evaluation attempt is not consumed until every item passes and the implementation-fidelity audit approves interpretation.

implementation_fidelity_review.timing: After all pre-economic production validation passes and before any aggregate return, Sharpe, gate, or strategy-performance conclusion is calculated or interpreted.
implementation_fidelity_review.scope: Frozen preregistration, v1 audit, source code, tests, exact input identity report, representative-real-row evidence, full trace hashes, mechanical reconciliation, failure precedence, holdout guard, and diff. The auditor may inspect development evidence needed for fidelity but must not calculate or state an economic conclusion.
implementation_fidelity_review.mechanical_rejection: IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED with a bounded repair round; it is not an economic rejection.
implementation_fidelity_review.interruption: AUDIT_PENDING with a retry only for timeout, context exhaustion, or temporary service failure.

formal_evaluation_and_audit_sequence.authorization: Commit the frozen preregistration, implementation, tests, production validation, and fidelity approval cleanly before the first formal aggregate economic calculation.
formal_evaluation_and_audit_sequence.run: One deterministic-local CPU evaluation of the exact 2024-2025 development window computes all seven trials, aggregate and four folds, standalone assets, benchmarks, doubled cost, additional delay, bootstrap, DSR, PBO, regimes, concentration, traces, and all 19 gates.
formal_evaluation_and_audit_sequence.post_run_mechanical_defect: An independent audit-proven mechanical defect may consume one of at most two post-run fidelity-repair rounds. Freeze the repair rationale before changing code; do not alter economics; rerun the full deterministic evaluation; preserve every invalidated result as contaminated evidence and count every observed trial toward future multiplicity.
formal_evaluation_and_audit_sequence.economic_no_go: A completed contract-faithful evaluation with any failed gate is HISTORICAL_NO_GO. Preserve and commit it, keep the holdout closed, audit independently, and terminalize only this exact v2 experiment.
formal_evaluation_and_audit_sequence.development_go: All 19 gates true produces DEVELOPMENT_GO_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT, not a candidate and not holdout authorization.
formal_evaluation_and_audit_sequence.independent_audit: Sol/xhigh live read-only audit independently recomputes methodology and returns from committed hashes and may approve the closed-holdout result, reject fidelity, or remain pending on service interruption. No timeout is an economic verdict.

holdout_contract.open_rule: Reused data contract remains PASS; every development gate passes; both implementation-fidelity and robustness audits pass; exact code, config, data manifest, environment, traces, and result are frozen, hashed, clean, and committed; a separate live Sol/xhigh pre-holdout audit returns HOLDOUT_OPEN_APPROVED.
holdout_contract.one_shot: Reject any pre-existing latch. Commit a hash-bound access authorization before resolving any 2026 path, then exclusive-create and arm the latch immediately before first access. Exactly one invocation; any post-arm error is terminal with no reset, deletion, repair, rerun, or reopen.
holdout_contract.other_gates: Every other development numerical, stress, parameter, asset, bootstrap, DSR, PBO, regime, concentration, leakage, trace, execution, accounting, and drawdown gate applies unchanged.

promotion_and_prospective_contract.historical_candidate_freeze: Only after all holdout gates and a separate live Sol/xhigh terminal audit pass.
promotion_and_prospective_contract.prospective_data: Every input, availability event, decision, target, and fill arrives strictly after candidate freeze; rebuild all warmup from post-freeze data.
promotion_and_prospective_contract.independent_asset_decision: One frozen desired-exposure computation for one asset after each eligible completed UTC session whether or not target changes; at most two per session and deduplicated by experiment, asset, and session.
promotion_and_prospective_contract.accounting: Identical frozen signal, state, execution, cost, gap, trace, and self-financing rules with no refit or gate change.

model_routing.fallback: Only a confirmed quota, rate-limit, throttling, or temporary model-unavailable error permits the documented fallback. Coding, test, data, economic, audit, or methodology failure never permits downgrade.
